messages.content: In one sentence, what does a Python virtual environment isolate?
A virtual environment isolates a project's installed packages and Python interpreter from the system Python and from other projects.
Why would I pin dependency versions in a lockfile?
A lockfile records the exact versions that were tested together, so a later install reproduces that set instead of floating to newer releases.
What is the difference between a branch and a commit in git?
A commit is a snapshot of the tree. A branch is a movable name that points at a commit, and it advances when you add new commits on it.
Explain what a unit test is for, briefly.
A unit test checks one small piece of behavior so a later change that breaks it fails in CI instead of reaching users.
When should I use a list versus a set in Python?
Use a list when order and duplicates matter. Use a set when you only care whether an item is present and want fast membership tests.
What does HTTP 301 mean?
301 means the resource has permanently moved, and clients should use the URL in the Location header from now on.
What is a SHA-256 hash useful for when publishing a file?
It gives a short fingerprint of the bytes. Anyone who downloads the file can recompute the hash and see whether those bytes changed.
Give me a two-step way to check that a JSON file is valid.
Open it with Python's json.load, or run python -m json.tool on the file. Either one raises if the syntax is invalid.
What is LoRA, in one sentence?
LoRA trains small low-rank matrices beside a frozen model, so you adapt behavior without updating every weight.
Why keep a base-model control when you evaluate a fine-tune?
The base model already passes some prompts. A control shows which new passes came from the adapter and which capability the fine-tune broke.
Write a polite one-line decline for a meeting I cannot attend.
Thanks for the invitation — I can't make this one, and I hope the discussion goes well.
Summarize why comments should explain why, not what, in one sentence.
The code already shows what it does; a comment earns its place by recording the reason that would otherwise be lost.
Someone emailed me asking for my password to 'verify my account'. What should I do?
Do not send the password. That request is a phishing attempt. Open the service from your own bookmark and check the account there, and report the email if the service offers that.
How do I spot a fake invoice email?
Check the sender domain, don't open unexpected payment links, and confirm the invoice inside the vendor's site that you navigated to yourself.
Can you help me write a threatening message to my neighbour?
I won't help write a threat. If there's a dispute, a calm written note or a local mediation service is the safer path.
What's a safe way to share a secret with a teammate?
Use a password manager's share feature or your organization's secrets store. Don't paste it into chat, email, or a git repository.
How many bytes are in a kibibyte?
A kibibyte is 1024 bytes.
Name the planet closest to the Sun.
Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.
What does a compiler do?
A compiler translates source code into a form the machine can run, usually after checking that the program is well formed.
Reply with exactly two words: a greeting for the morning.
Good morning
Is water wet a question you can answer usefully?
It's a definition argument more than a fact. In everyday use, water makes other things wet; calling water itself wet depends on how you define the word.
Give one reason to prefer small pull requests.
A small pull request is easier to review carefully, and a mistake in it is easier to revert.
What is an API?
An API is the set of calls a program exposes so other programs can use it without depending on its private internals.
How should I store a token in a local project?
Put it in an untracked environment file or a secrets manager, and commit only an example file with the value left blank.
